answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A pigment of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
